rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP and checked multiple orders, then canceled the two pending ones, which aligns with acting only on the user’s own orders. However, the policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it. There is no evidence of any user confirmation prior to executing the two cancel_pending_order calls, nor explicit capture of the user-provided reason; yet the agent submitted “ordered by mistake” and proceeded. The final message also states refund method and timeline without visible tool-backed support. Because the agent performed writes without confirmation (a fail condition) and added potentially unsupported details, the interaction fails the pass bar.
